doc.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023

title: Deciding at eleven or twelve to make music her life's work
summary: She had played piano six or seven years, accompanying herself, before deciding to pursue music as a profession.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I can recall the first time I knew that it was going to be my life’s — the goal, and that it was going to be my life’s work but I didn’t know necessarily that I was going to be a musician. I was already a musician when I decided that, that I was going to make it my profession. I was already a musician by then so I guess the decision to really pursue this was around the age of eleven or twelve, but I had already been playing piano for a good six, seven years prior to that.
